parsed.rationale_overall: System B demonstrates stronger personalization by repeatedly tying recommendations to specific profile attributes (age 55, $80-100k income goal, loss comfort 5/10, occupation, $1.8M target) and provides more concrete actionable steps with specific dollar amounts and glide-path schedules. System A has slightly better factual grounding (B introduces KO and MCD tickers not in the portfolio and makes some unsupported quantitative claims), but B's superior personalization and actionability outweigh this on balance.
